title: Addressing Homelessness in Austin
summary:
*   Austin leaders held a public discussion focused on the complex issue of homelessness.
*   The session was part of a community event organized by Austin Interfaith, featuring insights from Foundation Communities.
*   Council members participated by responding to community input and hearing a "Call to Action" from the organizers.
*   This was an informational meeting for dialogue; no formal policy decisions or votes were taken.
